prompt: Which are recognized first steps for contributing to an unfamiliar open source project? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Etiquette is the entry ticket: read the norms, pick a starter issue, make sure you are not the third person on the same bug. Direct pushes upstream are what write access — and tact — prevent.

options.text: Read the README and CONTRIBUTING guide
Look for issues labeled `good first issue`
Check existing issues and pull requests before opening your own
Push your branch straight to the upstream repository
Start by rewriting the project’s architecture
